---
description: How note_set, the tool for your own line on a level of the world's tree, is called. It says how to call it, not when. Delete this file and an agent that finds it by search is given no such guide.
---
note_set puts your own line `text` on a level `at`: a person, a thing, a place or the world, by name. It shows beside that level in world_query and in the next world state, and it changes nothing in the world. Empty text takes the line off. It takes no `source`.

    tool_use {"name": "note_set", "args": {"at": "Bram", "text": "uneasy since the fire"}}
